audit.framing_9x16: Full vertical crop of high-action gameplay paired with perfectly synced beat drops and character movements.
audit.subtitle_craft: Minimalist textual elements centered around gameplay milestones, timed cleanly with fast rhythmic music.
audit.zoom_and_camera_work: Dynamic camera cuts and pans matched perfectly to the song beats, creating an energetic flow without losing visual clarity.
audit.sfx_and_music_craft: Heavy reliance on a trending phonk/rap audio track with sharp beat-sync cuts on every major action (crafting, mining, portal entry, boss fight).
audit.comedic_timing_and_cuts: Lightning-fast cuts that compress an entire Minecraft playthrough into a tight narrative progression from spawning to defeating the Ender Dragon.
standout_techniques: Beat-synced transitions between different game stages
Seamless matching of player actions to rhythm spikes
Rapid progression pacing to maintain high retention
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Overuse of watermarks obscuring central actions
Extremely rapid flashing that can become disorienting
